checks.detail: representation_type adds only a qualified two-variant shape with first empty and second exactly one immutable Address whose pointee is existing Copy data. It does not inspect Option spelling or metadata to manufacture identity or a root. Full qualified Types remain in verified and LIR function/value tables.

Slice is not a Copy value type. Address<Slice> therefore fails this new predicate and direct store guard, preserving Unsupported rather than truncating {ptr,len} to ptr. Mutable Address and other physical variant shapes remain excluded.

checks.property: Existing union layout and tag discipline
checks.detail: Reuses the existing i32 tag plus aligned maximum-payload area. Thin pointer storage is llvm_type(Address)=ptr, physical alignment8 and one payload i64 word; the existing LLVM struct is {i32,[1 x i64]} with native64 size16/alignment8. Existing union initialization remains. ReadVariant checks actual tag and traps on mismatch before payload read.

The only new payload store arm takes immutable Address<Copy>, uses its actual LLVM type and physical alignment, and emits one ordinary store. No integer truncation, heap box, RC, lock, runtime table, destructor or new lifetime operation is introduced.

Newly reachable MakeVariant payload emission is included in the existing canonical store reservation when no snapshot already pays for it. Shared Address canonical work is a single leaf and pays the existing16 multiplier. Existing complete type metadata visits prepay representation/layout queries; no default limit or formal performance gate is changed. This reviewer did not measure a new exact codegen boundary.

Uses existing enum machine shape and helper argument/result lowering. Full qualified metadata remains part of the checked snapshot/fingerprint, and bind_lir still requires exact executable and type table correspondence. No public callable/foreign ABI permission is added.
